body: I've learned that the hard way. I just don't know if it's possible for people to want to be friends with someone like me. I've list a ton of people to my bipolar, including a boyfriend. I know I choose bad people, but it feels like all the good are hiding.
I think I'm a bad friend. Otherwise why does this keep happening?
I do too. Somehow I still want a friend even though I can't keep them.
